Jobs are [name,positive duration] with unique string names. All arrive at time 0 in list order. Repeatedly run the front job for min(quantum, remaining), then requeue unfinished jobs. Return [name,completion_time] in completion order. quantum >= 1.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      [
        "A",
        4
      ],
      [
        "B",
        1
      ]
    ],
    2
  ],
  "expected": [
    [
      "B",
      3
    ],
    [
      "A",
      5
    ]
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [],
    3
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

A deque naturally moves unfinished jobs to the back.

Complexity: O(sum(ceil(duration/quantum))) time, O(number of jobs) space
